lede: Indianapolis Colts carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#11 in EPA per play), while Pittsburgh Steelers owns the more favourable defensive matchup (#18 in EPA allowed per play).
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Pittsburgh Steelers +0.9 with a fair total of 46.3 — approximately a one-score game, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Indianapolis Colts run offence vs Pittsburgh Steelers run defence, which sits +0.058 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is availability: NFL injury report — not loaded in this session.
